source: Tabletop arrived with gouges through the lacquer.
Varnish on cabinet doors was patchy and blistered.
Chair legs wobble because the dowels do not fit snugly.
Bolt holes on the shelf brackets do not line up.
Outer cardboard crushed; protective foam was absent.

The mirror shattered and glass door panel is cracked.
